sentences.text: A prospective longitudinal study involving 501 people with Lewy body disease, Alzheimer disease, and healthy controls examined how changes in blood pTau217 levels over two to five years linked to changes in daily functioning and cognitive test scores over two to eight years.

Scientists categorized participants as having abnormal or normal pTau217 levels based on a specific threshold derived from amyloid PET scans to compare their rates of clinical decline, finding that a quicker rise in pTau217 levels over time was connected to a more rapid increase in scores measuring daily functional impairment.
The authors conclude that pTau217 is a useful tool for predicting and monitoring disease progression in Lewy body disease, especially in groups with mixed brain pathologies.
